Usage: skilllint check [OPTIONS] [paths]...

  Validate Claude Code plugins, skills, agents, and commands.

Arguments:
  paths...  Paths to validate

Options:
  --check              Validate only, don't auto-fix
  --fix                Auto-fix issues where possible
  -v, --verbose        Show detailed output
  --no-color           Disable color
  --tokens-only        Output token count only
  --show-progress      Show per-file status
  --show-summary       Show summary panel
  --filter <str>       Glob pattern
  --filter-type <str>  Filter type
  --platform <str>     Platform adapter. Choices: claude-code, codex, cursor
  --record <path>      Record terminal output to SVG or HTML file
  --include-gitignore  Scan files that are excluded by .gitignore rules. By default, gitignored paths are skipped.
  --help               Show this message and exit.
